gloss: to ship directly; to send straight

definitions.gloss: to ship directly; to send straight to the destination
definitions.explanation: To send goods or products directly from the source (producer, factory, farm) to the customer or destination without going through intermediaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{直送|ちょくそう}する。
examples.english: To ship directly from the production area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{海産物|かいさんぶつ}→海産物：13394_kaisanbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直送|ちょくそう}します。
examples.english: We ship fresh seafood directly from Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{直送|ちょくそう}された⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧マージン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かからない→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Since the products are shipped directly from the factory, there's no middleman markup.

notes:
A common word in commerce and food marketing. Very frequently seen on food packaging and restaurant advertising to emphasize freshness and quality by highlighting the direct-from-source supply chain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧: shipped straight from the production area
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧: factory-direct shipping
- ⟦{漁港|ぎょこう}→漁港：20623_gyokou⟧⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧: shipped straight from the fishing port
- ⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧: shipped directly from the farm
- ⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧: direct shipment service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}する→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧: to ship, dispatch — general word for sending out goods; does not imply direct sourcing
- ⟦{配送|はいそう}する→配送する：21738_haisousuru⟧: to deliver — focuses on the delivery process rather than the directness of the route
- {直販|ちょくはん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sell directly — selling directly to consumers, not just shipping

USAGE:
The noun form ⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦{直送|ちょくそう}→直送：13824_chokusou⟧ is extremely common in advertising and menus, functioning almost as a quality label.
